items.q: Cicarella and fellow Republican state Senators Henri Martin, Heather Somers and Stephen Harding called the decision "outrageous" and "mind-boggling.

record.t: Stepped in as Senate Republican caucus leader, replacing Kevin Kelly, who resigned from the post.
record.q: Connecticut state Sen. Minority Leader Kevin Kelly unexpectedly resigned on Friday as the Republican caucus leader, and first-term state Sen. Stephen Harding stepped in as his replacement.
